## Japan Fall Foliage Forecast 2026: Best Time & Places for Autumn Leaves
Aug 04, 2026|posted by _WANGKIRA_

Known as _momijigari_ in Japan, the tradition of enjoying autumn leaves follows a very different pattern from cherry blossom season. The colors move **from north to south**, **starting in Hokkaido** and the mountain regions before reaching cities like Tokyo, Kyoto, and Osaka **in November**. The season stretches for about **two and a half months**, so the best timing depends heavily on where you plan to go.

## Japan Autumn Leaves Forecast 2026
The Japan Meteorological Corporation (JMC) releases its first nationwide autumn leaves forecast in early September and updates it throughout the season.

![Japan Autumn Leaves Forecast 2026 Map](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0676/5353/3890/files/1071490900521386034.jpg?v=1773916225)Japan Autumn Leaves

Because autumn temperatures vary each year, peak foliage dates can shift by one to two weeks. If you are booking your Japan trip months in advance, secure flights and hotels first, but keep your [autumn foliage day trips](https://www.keepgoodtrip.com/collections/fall-foliage-tours) flexible based on the latest weather updates.

## Best Time to See Autumn Leaves in Japan by Region
| **Region** | **Typical Peak** | **2026 Prediction** | **Top Spots** |
|-|-|-|-|
| **Hokkaido & Tohoku** | Mid-Oct to Early Nov | Late Oct to Mid-Nov | Daisetsuzan, Oirase Gorge, Naruko Gorge |
| **Kanto (Tokyo/Hakone)** | Mid-Nov to Late Nov | Late Nov to Early Dec | Rikugien, Lake Ashi ( [Hakone](https://www.keepgoodtrip.com/blogs/japan-travel/hakone-one-day-itinerary)), Hakone Gora Park |
| **Chubu (Fuji/Alps)** | Late Oct to Mid-Nov | Early Nov to Late Nov | Lake Kawaguchiko, Chureito Pagoda, Kamikochi |
| **Kansai (Kyoto/Osaka)** | Mid-Nov to Late Nov | Late Nov to Early Dec | Arashiyama, Eikando, Katsuoji Temple, Kiyomizu-dera |
| **Kyushu** | Late Nov to Early Dec | Early Dec to Mid-Dec | Mt. Aso, Fukuoka, Yabakei |

## FAQs About Japan Fall Foliage
For Tokyo, [Kyoto](https://www.keepgoodtrip.com/blogs/japan-travel/kyoto-one-day-itinerary), and Osaka, the best chance of seeing peak autumn colors is from mid-November to early December 2026.

# Japan Fall Foliage: 2026 Autumn Leaves Forecast Map
From red maple leaves to ginkgo in their golden hue, dotted in shrines, or floating on the water, let the vibrant fall foliage in their bright colors accompany you on your autumn [Japan tour](https://www.odynovotours.com/japan-tours/). For the optimal time and locations to capture the splendid fall colors, consult the latest 2026 autumn leaves forecast to enhance your Japan visual feast this fall.

## Japan Autumn Leaves Forecast Map 2026
Japan's fall foliage season in 2026 will be postponed due to the warm temperatures this year.

![Japan Fall Foliage Forecast Map 2025](https://media.odynovotours.com/article/81000/japan-autumn-leaves-forcast-2025-1_80334.png)_Japan Fall Foliage Forecast Map 2026_

Japan's fall foliage season is like a wave from north to south: varying by region, ever-changing, yet somewhat predictable. Usually starting from late September, inside the verdant forests of Hokkaido, the rolling stroll of the fall colors gradually unfolds with the chilly winds, painting all of Japan into a tapestry of red and gold.

# Japan Fall Foliage 2026 Forecast: 25 Destinations and Tips
Japan's 2026 autumn foliage season runs from mid-September in Hokkaido to December in Tokyo and Kyoto.

This is the official account of MATCHA's editorial department.

## Japan Autumn Foliage Forecast 2026
The 2026 forecast is yet to be announced.

In Japan, the foliage turns vibrant shades of red and yellow first in colder regions such as Hokkaido, typically starting around **mid-September** in Daisetsuzan National Park.

The fall colors gradually spread from north to south and from higher to lower elevations. The peak viewing season is generally in **Tokyo in late November**, and in **Kyoto and Osaka from late November to early December**.
